summary: Camarines Sur 1st District representative with 242 principal-authored bills. Authored FOI and a right-to-information implementation bill, bank transparency and anti-corruption mechanisms (two bills), an anti-dynasty ban, penalties for malicious false information and a plastic-bag excise.
caveat: Only 7 rubric bills surfaced from 242. Disinformation and plastic-excise items are single issues in their dimensions and unscored.

economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
